#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);

    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> arr[i];
    }

    vector<int> dp(n, 0);
    int even = 0, odd = 0;
    int j = 1;  // dp[0] is unused
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        if (arr[i] % 2 == 0)
            even++;
        else
            odd++;
        if (even == odd) {
            dp[j] = abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i]);
            j++;
        }
    }

    sort(dp.begin(), dp.begin() + j);

    int l = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < j; i++) {
        dp[i] += dp[i - 1];
        if (dp[i] <= b) {
            l = i;
        }
    }

    cout << l << endl;

    return 0;
}
